title: Distributional Alignment of LLMs and Its Generalization Properties
abstract: arXiv:2610.31687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate and probe human behavior, e.g., for surveys. For these applications, a key property is that outputs satisfy distributional alignment: to match its output distribution with some reference (in this case, human) distribution. An obstacle in achieving distributional alignment is generalizing from small training data. In this work, we study (1) how to distributionally align LLMs; and (2) how aligned LLMs might generalize to unseen samples and unrelated topics and tasks. Using two large-scale benchmarks, we find that LLMs can indeed achieve distributional alignment and generalize to unseen questions of the same domain. Cross-topic generalization depends on the relationship between topics (e.g., questions about politics are related to trust in institutions). However, aligned LLMs can degrade in surprising ways (e.g., lose their creative ability), suggesting that its generalization proper

translated_title: 大语言模型的分布对齐及其泛化特性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于模拟和探究人类行为，例如用于问卷调查。对于这些应用而言，一个关键属性是输出满足分布对齐：即模型的输出分布与某种参考（此处为人类）分布相匹配。实现分布对齐的一个障碍是如何从少量训练数据中进行泛化。在这项工作中，我们研究了：(1) 如何对大语言模型进行分布对齐；(2) 对齐后的大语言模型如何泛化到未见过的样本以及不相关的主题和任务。通过两个大规模基准测试，我们发现大语言模型确实可以实现分布对齐，并能泛化到同一领域中未见过的的问题。跨主题泛化则取决于主题之间的关系（例如，关于政治的问题与对机构的信任相关）。然而，对齐后的大语言模型可能会以令人惊讶的方式发生退化（例如，失去其创造力），这表明其泛化特性……
tldr: 该研究提出了大语言模型与人类分布对齐的方法，发现对齐后的模型能够泛化到同领域的未见问题，跨主题泛化取决于主题间的关联性，但可能伴随创造力等能力的意外退化。
en_tdlr: This work studies how to distributionally align LLMs with human reference distributions, showing that aligned models generalize to unseen questions within the same domain and across related topics, but may unexpectedly degrade in abilities such as creativity.
